title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing Assistant - York

Brooklyn Recruitment are currently working with a well established yet rapidly expanding abrasives tooling business. They are looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant to be office based in the York area. This is a brand new role to the business so is a great opportunity to really make it your own.

As Digital Marketing Assistant your role will be extremely varied, and your duties will include:
- Planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.
- Managing the social media channels.
- Creating social media posts and videos.
- Designing email campaigns.
- Updating the website.
- Ensuring the brand values are highlighted and all items are kept on brand.
- Assisting other members of the marketing team.
- Maintaining the marketing library.
- Other duties as required

As Digital Marketing Assistant, you will be rewarded with a generous salary, a pension scheme, 25 days holiday, a great team environment and a chance to really shape the digital marketing role.

The hours of work for this role of Digital Marketing Assistant are Mon - Fri 9am - 5pm.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Consortium Professional Recruitment are working with an established organisation in Pocklington to find a Finance Assistant who enjoys being involved, taking responsibility and making sure things happen when they should. You'll be joining a team where your contribution will be valued, with the opportunity to work across several areas of finance rather than being limited to one particular task.

The Opportunity:
As a Finance Assistant, you'll be involved in the financial activities that help keep a busy organisation running effectively.

You'll have the opportunity to:
- Process accurate monthly payroll, including PAYE, workplace pensions, P60s and P11 Ds.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers, process invoices, expenses and supplier payments, and assist with credit control.
- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations, administer petty cash and maintain fixed asset records.
- Support month-end and year-end activities, VAT returns and annual accounts preparation.
- Your work will directly contribute to a well-organised finance function, supporting informed decisions and helping the wider organisation operate with confidence.

About You:
You might already be working in an accounts team, supporting payroll or handling a mixture of finance responsibilities. What's important is that you're comfortable with numbers, enjoy finding solutions and can be relied upon to follow things through.

We're particularly interested in hearing from people who bring:
- Practical experience in finance or payroll, with an understanding of how accurate financial information supports a business.
- The confidence to work with spreadsheets, financial systems and detailed information.
- A methodical approach, with the ability to spot when something doesn't look quite right.
- The initiative to manage your own workload while knowing when to ask questions or involve others.
- A friendly, professional manner and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Knowledge of Sage or Xero would be useful.

If you're studying towards AAT that's an added bonus.

The Benefits and Package:
In return, you'll enjoy:
- £29,000 to £32,000 depending on experience.
- Life insurance, healthcare scheme, company pension and 25 holidays + bank holidays
- A broad role offering exposure to payroll, financial accounting, reporting and audit processes.
- Opportunity to develop your career and complete further qualifications.
- Collaborative team working alongside an experienced and supportive Finance Manager

How to Apply:
If you're a Finance Assistant looking for a role with greater variety, or you're currently working in accounts or payroll and ready for your next move, we'd be pleased to hear from you!

This exciting Finance Assistant / Payroll Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach.

If you're ready to take the next step in your finance career, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.

Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. We regularly receive large responses to our advertising which can make providing individual feedback to every applicant challenging. If you haven't received a reply from us within 14 days of your application, we regret to say your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We have a policy of retaining your details for future vacancies unless you request otherwise. To learn more about our services, please visit consortiumrecruitment.co.uk

title: Finance Assistant

Looking for a career where your ambition meets real opportunity? Join Persimmon Homes as an Finance Assistant and step into a role where your success is celebrated, your growth supported, and your work truly matters.

Persimmon Homes is one of the UK's largest and most established housebuilders, listed on the FTSE 100, with 29 regional offices and thousands of quality homes built every year.

At Persimmon, we don't just build homes - we build careers. When you join us as Finance Assistant, you'll benefit from:

- Life Cover: Benefit from life cover as part of your employment package.

title: Financial Services Administrator

description:
Financial Services Administrator

Are you organised, detail-oriented and passionate about delivering an excellent client experience? Do you have experience in financial services and enjoy keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes?

A Financial Services Administrator is required to support a team of financial advisers, who pride themselves on integrity, professionalism and putting clients first.

What's in it for you?

We believe in investing in our people and helping them thrive. In return, the Financial Services Administrator will get:

Competitive salary
Flexible working, Monday to Friday 37.5 hrs with one day working from home as an option
Study support and opportunities to develop your skills
Healthcare support
Pension scheme
Cycle to work scheme
A supportive team culture
Career progression and recognition

What will you be doing as a Financial Services Administrator?

You'll play a key role in supporting advisers and ensuring clients receive an efficient, professional service. Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing new business applications across pensions, investments and protection products.
- Managing Letters of Authority and liaising with providers.
- Preparing client review packs and supporting ongoing client servicing.
- Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) checks and supporting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.
- Maintaining accurate client records and keeping cases moving within agreed timescales.
- Supporting transfers, withdrawals, fund switches and other client administration.
- Working closely with clients, advisers, providers and paraplanners to deliver a seamless service.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is proactive, professional and takes pride in getting the details right.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in financial planning, wealth management or an IFA environment.
- A good understanding of financial services administration.
- Experience with KYC and AML checks.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- The ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy.
- Knowledge of pensions, investments and protection products.

Experience with Intelligent Office, Xplan or similar back-office systems would be an advantage.

If you're looking for a role where your skills are valued, your development is supported and your contribution makes a difference, and you think you could be our next Financial Services Administrator we'd love to hear from you!
